items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related field or discipline and/or equivalent training and experience.

Extensive experience and understanding of academic recruitment process (faculty recruitment highly preferred) including online application management, advertising, interviewing and search committee oversight
Experience working in the following systems: UC Recruit, MyInfoVault, APHID, Airtable, PeopleSoft, and Outlook.
Experience and working knowledge of Microsoft Suite.
Experience using campus and school Recruit/payroll/personnel systems.
At least two years experience in Academic Health system setting

Under the direction of the Department Manager, this position serves as an academic recruitment subject matter expert and works collaboratively with the Recruitment Lead and all Academic Personnel teams to manage day-to-day recruitment activities and provide high-level analytical support to the Associate Vice Chancellor, Assistant Dean, Department Manager, School/Department leadership and staff. This position also serves as a liaison to the Office of the Vice Provost-Academic Affairs and the Academic Personnel staff; provides policy interpretation, analysis and best practice recommendations related to academic personnel policies; assist in the development and implementation of new School, campus and system procedures and provides training to all levels of internal and external staff and faculty.
Excellent interpersonal, communication (written and oral), and customer service.
Knowledge and understanding of Academic Personnel Manual policies and academic bargaining unit contracts.
Working knowledge of virtual interview software.
Demonstrated analytical decision-making, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge and understanding of Academic Personnel Manual policies and academic bargaining unit contracts.
Accomplished multi-tasking, organization and discipline skills.
Detail oriented with excellent project management skills.
